The City's Active Building Permits list of 26 October 2026 (evidence 6424fa30, also already on the site) carries the Equinix data-centre fit-out permit 2026-134965-CI at 127 Great Oaks Bl on APN 706-02-060 (owner Equinix LLC), one of the two county parcels whose union is the campus locator. additions.name: AVAIO Digital Leo (Project Leo) — planned AI-ready data center and power campus on 296 acres

status.summary: AVAIO Digital's campus page for Leo, in its version of 25 August 2026, identifies Project Leo as a 296-acre AI-ready data center and power campus on 145th Street in Pulaski County near Little Rock, with 1,070 MW of planned total baseload power (570 MW grid and 500 MW behind the meter), an executed Entergy Arkansas electric service agreement for initial grid capacity to be energized in Q4 2027 and an initial fully contracted capacity planned to be online by 2027. This dated company disclosure names and locates the project, so it is recorded as announced as of 25 August 2026, the date of the page version (dateModified, bounded by Internet Archive copies of 19 August and 4 September 2026). The page also says AVAIO 'has broken ground' and that the site 'has a fully approved Site Plan'; neither statement is dated or tied to a recorded permit, so no permit or physical-work stage is asserted. Energization and capacity dates are forecasts, and no current IT capacity is established.

locator.precision: Planar centroid (computed in UTM 15N) of the union of three contiguous Pulaski County tax parcels owned by ADP LITTLE ROCK DATA HUB LLC, as published in the Arkansas GIS Office statewide parcel layer: 35R-024.00-023.00 (E 145th St, 209.97 geodesic acres), 35R-024.13-001.00 (McDonald Rd, 38.50 acres, enclosed by the first) and 35R-019.00-068.00 (E 145th St, 41.97 acres). The union is one polygon of 290.44 geodesic acres, about 1,463 by 1,055 m; the point lies inside it, 410 m from its boundary, and the native NAD83 / UTM 15N cross-check differs by 0.91 m. It locates the campus property, not a building footprint, works extent or surveyed boundary.
locator.identity_review: AVAIO's Leo page gives the location as 145th Street, Little Rock, Pulaski County, the size as 296 acres and the campus coordinate as 34.623375, -92.246825. A point query of the statewide parcel layer at that coordinate returns only parcel 35R-024.00-023.00, situs E 145TH ST, owned by ADP LITTLE ROCK DATA HUB LLC; with its two adjoining parcels of the same owner the property totals 290.44 geodesic acres, matching the stated 296 acres. AVAIO's 12 January 2026 release names the company AVAIO Digital Partners, and its Appomattox County project (already in the Atlas) is held by ADP Appomattox Data Hub, LLC, the same naming pattern. The coordinate lies 291 m north-north-east of the selected centroid and 147 m inside the union boundary. The point is outside every municipal boundary in the Arkansas GIS Office layer, in unincorporated Pulaski County. Two parcels of ADP LITTLE ROCK GREEN COMPUTE LLC in section 13 (about 39.5 acres) are a separately named entity and are not included. No geocoder, map viewport, city centre or county centroid is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The statewide layer describes its polygons as approximate tax-parcel locations and publishes no positional accuracy; the centroid represents a 290-acre three-parcel property about 1.5 by 1.1 km, and no building or phase position is published.
